text:
lina: FYI we're doing a midnight rolling reboot (kernel rollback) across eu-west3 to mitigate the new blk-cve regression. window: 00:30-03:30 UTC. impact: short pod restarts, GPUs will be drained per-node. please read plan below and call out any tenant blockers.

sam: ack. rough plan? how many nodes per cohort?

lina: cohort size 8 nodes, stagger 10m between cohorts. will run canary cohort first (2 nodes) for 30m. autoscaler will backfill but we've set capacity-hedge to reserved pools.

maria: tagging priority tenants now — can we avoid touching dedicated pools for finance-prod?

lina: yes — finance-prod is pinned to dedicated-us-eu pool, excluded from the drain job. only hitting shared-hosted and interruptible pools.

jordan: ops-oncall, can you confirm alert routing for any prolonged pod evictions? want traces to go to #incidents if >5m.

ops-oncall: oncall here. alert rule updated: If pod_eviction_time > 300s and >5% of pool capacity impacted -> page SRE. I'll also enable temporary quieter thresholds for infra noise.

sam: what's the drain command? will we run a pre-check script?

lina: preflight checks run 30m prior: `./scripts/node-health-check --pool eu-west3 --cohort $COHORT` then `kubectl cordon $NODE && kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120`

maria: please ensure kv-cache warmup step after each cohort — recent warm cache helps avoid cold token latency spikes.

lina: good catch. plan includes a `kv-warmup` job that seeds hot prefixes for 20m after each cohort finish.

devx-bot: deploy-bot: Canary cohort started on cohort-0 at 1769993400. Logs: `canary-drain: node-a1 drained, node-a2 drained, seed-started`

sam: if canary looks clean, what's our rollback plan?

lina: rollback is automated: if error rate >1.5x baseline or avg token latency +50ms sustained 10m -> abort remaining cohorts and reimage canary nodes to previous kernel. configs: `rollback_thresholds.yaml` in the runbook.

jordan: cost note — warmup jobs will add ~0.8 GPU-hours per cohort. total expected bill impact ~6 GPU-hours for full window. tagging will be applied to cost center infra-maint-2026.

maria: audience comms? should we post to #customer-success for tenants with >5% traffic from eu-west3?

lina: will post a short heads-up to #customer-success and #status 1h before start + a follow-up if we abort. template in runbook.

ops-oncall: I'll be in the channel for the window and will escalate if network flaps appear. please don't hesitate to @ops-oncall.

sam: thanks. I'll watch canary and run perf probes (rps/latency) during the warmup step.

lina: great. final checklist: preflight health checks ✅, exclusion list applied ✅, kv-warmup job ready ✅, alerting thresholds updated ✅. starting canary at 00:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
